hints.title: Level-Wise Maze Exploration
hints.text: Explore cells in order of increasing step count from the starting location to identify the closest perimeter opening.

hints.title: Boundary Exit Criteria
hints.text: An empty cell is considered an exit if it sits on the grid perimeter and is not the original entrance coordinates.

hints.title: Avoiding Re-Visiting Cells
hints.text: Mark cells as visited or overwrite them with wall tokens immediately upon enqueueing to prevent redundant traversal cycles.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Standard level-order breadth exploration across unweighted grid graph.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Depth-first search does not guarantee discovering the minimal steps first without exploring all paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: FIFO queue processes cells layer by layer to guarantee earliest exit arrival.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize shortest path in unweighted graphs requires level-order traversal.
